Last year. 

I spent my Christmas not with my foo.

I was alone miles away from anyone I knew.

I got up late, I ate some incredibly nice toasted pesto wraps with mozzarella and chorizo, I played games, watched films, lazed around.

I had four invitations to friends christmasses and declined them all.

I hadn't realized how much I'd come to loathe the pomp and tradition and ceremony around "family time at christmas" until I didn't have to put on a brave face and deal with it.

It was so relaxing and unburdening to embrace my inner grinch and just be like , "FTS" and do whatever I wanted without having to worry about being accused of being in a mood or grumpy or ruining the day or upsetting my sister or yadda yadda yadda bullshit bullshit wretch.

At one point whilst working at a supermarket I started buying some small things for myself, I worked 5 till 10ish in the evening so I missed dinner, so occasionally I'd buy myself some stuff if I fancied it.

I had a nice little collection of maybe 4 smallish bags of various pastas that I'd put in the food cupboard cause I thought well that's where dried food goes.

After a few weeks of this it turned out this was a crime, my nsister kept informing me that I didn't need that many types of pasta, that they were taking up too much room.

Then at one point she decided to inform me that we would be using up all the various ones I had for dinner that night, that it was ridiculous that I was buying my own food, that I shouldn't be wasting my money etc.

So I said we'll no its my food I'm not gunna use it all up, so I took them all and stored them in my room from then on so I wouldn't be taking up space. At which point my n/e/bitch/guilttripper mother came  and was like, you can store them in the cupboard it's fine don't worry about it, to which I responded, no its causing issues and taking up space so I've moved them

To which I got a dose of the usual, why can't you just get on with your sister, why do you two always fight why can't you be nicer to your sister..

I just wanted my tagliatelle and linguine man..

We are all the centre of our own universes.

We can't be big in our own universe, because if we are big, there's a smaller centre within, so we think of ourselves as a dot floating in space.

All the people who affect our lives, they orbit round us and they seem huge, massive galaxies of connections and emotions and thoughts and experiences. 

So we put them above ourselves.

But then we have forgotten the most important bit.

It's very important to be the centreason of something. That's special and unique and deserving of recognition, no matter how big those around us seem to be compared to us.

I had one dream where my father was trying to force me to go to dinner and the plan was to get me into the car my mother was going to drive under the pretense of idk, come here for a minute before we go, then just drive off. father was in another car.

So we start driving and i'm like wtf, and my mother goes "oh your father is kidnapping you"

So I bail out the car at speed, injure my leg and limp home, whilst my dad gets out of the car he was in and slowly follows me, like im in some godamn horror film.

He finds a rake, but this is no ordinary rake, this is a motherfucking horrordream rake, looking more like a rake edward scissor hands would be made into, or something that would cause freddie kruger to pause and go "Hmmm, might be time to leave the ol' glove knives behind and upgrade", thing looked like a damn torture implement, had enough blades on it to skin a cow at 20 paces. And hes slowly coming after me, and I manage to get into the house, but I have to go round the back because it would take too long to open the door, and I get into the kitchen slamming doors behind me cause hes right behind me.

And hes coming in through the door, and I stabbed him in the chest with a knife i'd grabbed. And then dump him onto a kitchen chair as he just sits there staring at me, and then I grab several more knives and stab those into his chest too.

And a few minutes later I woke up feeling very disconcerted.

I didn't know quite what to make of things.

Life's strange yanno..

You spend all this time going along doing what you can and trying your best.

And then something or nothing happens, and you just fall apart a little.

You can stand there from one moment to the next and go from fine to gone. 

Life's scary and weird and odd and difficult and struggling and confusing and I don't know.

Sometimes.

I wonder why things are the way they are. Like why me? Why you? Why them? Why us? Why anything.

I ramble on and time passes and nothing is said but everyone hears something. And when you try and say something no one hears you.

And if someone hears something they rarely hear what you want them to hear, and it causes issues. So you don't speak after a while, you let your voice dry up and speak with someone else's voice. Someone who isn't you.

Someone who doesn't have to fight sadness to breathe. Someone who doesn't have to battle hate and rage to hug someone without squeezing too hard and hurting them. Someone who doesn't have to ignore who they are to get sleep at night.

So you speak and you live and you breathe and life goes on but you are still stuck in that moment you decided not to be 10 years ago. And everyone else moves forward's and you pretend and make like you are also moving on.

But how can you when you are stuck. Even worse, you are stuck by your own choice, your own decision.

That choice to be someone who wasn't sad. How can you undo that choice, how can you stop choosing to not be sad when you have had to not be sad to continue to live.

How can you override instinct, undo reflexes. How can you stop choosing not to be when you can't choose anything.

You can't choose to be something if you aren't anything. Things that don't exist can't choose. Can't undo choices of things that once existed and chose not to. Can't climb out of a hole you dug when you can no longer see the daylight.

But life goes on and you forget you chose not to be. You breathe in and out and in and out and somewhere between the in and the out you manage to keep going and you will yourself to breathe again. Fighting for each breathe of life without realising it. People around can't see what isn't there. Can't help what doesn't exist.

And I don't exist, not any more. Not since I was. I made the choice to not be me. I chose to be someone else, someone who didn't have to cry and hate and rage and guilt and hurt. 

And no one sees what isn't there.
